Mother Gothel’s Hazelnut Soup 
Inspired by Tangled Serves 4

Ingredients 
- ¾ cup (100 g) raw hazelnuts, skins removed 
- 1½ medium parsnips (about 200 g), peeled and sliced 
- 1 medium leek (white and light green parts only), sliced and well washed 
- 1 small shallot, thinly sliced 
- 1 tbsp unsalted butter 
- 3 cups (720 ml) vegetable stock or light chicken broth 
- ½ cup (120 ml) whole milk 
- ¼ cup (60 ml) heavy cream 
- 3–4 sprigs fresh thyme 
- Salt, to taste 
- ¼ tsp black pepper 
- Pinch of nutmeg 

For serving 
Chopped toasted hazelnuts 
Fresh thyme 
Drizzle of olive oil 
Small drizzle of cream 
Toasted Rustic bread, for dipping 

Instructions 
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Toast hazelnuts for 10–12 minutes until fragrant. 
2. Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat. Add leeks and shallot with a pinch of salt. Cook gently until very soft and sweet, without browning. 
3. Add parsnips, hazelnuts, stock, and thyme. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 20–25 mi
title: Mother Gothel's Hazelnut & Parsnip Soup | Food of Fantasy
